title: The Sauganash's rear roof joins its main ridge
items: A reconstructed joint brings the rear roof to the main ridge. The footprint, walls, roof pitch, outer wing length and existing site stay as before.
The two brick chimney shafts are narrower, with their positions, heights and plain heads retained. The selected width is a working reconstruction, not a measurement read from the engraving.
Andreas and Braunhold's retrospective picture guides the relative forms. The trial still needs its rebuilt source comparisons and street review; no historical camera or alteration date is claimed.
